html:
SMTO-MEM-0007 — This memory is too large to save

GUID: 140e97b8-a044-477d-beb4-923295e3b24b
Slug: memory-value-too-large
Domain: MEM · Subsystem: mem

What happened

  • The memory's content is bigger than the limit of about 1 MB for one memory, so SMTO didn't save it. Any earlier version of this memory is unchanged.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In the Memory Editor, shorten Content by removing long logs, pasted files or repeated text the agent doesn't need to remember. Each memory can hold about 1 MB, so removing bulky text brings it under the limit.
  2. If you need all of it, split it into several memories with related keys, such as notes.part-1 and notes.part-2, and save each one. Each memory is checked against the limit separately, so smaller parts can each be saved complete.
  3. If the agent hit this while saving, ask it to save a short summary instead of the full text. The agent tried to store more than one memory can hold, and a summary fits.

What success looks like

  • Each memory shows Saved and appears in the Memories list with its complete content.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't cut the content off at a random point just to make it fit; you could lose the part that matters.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • canonical_json serialized the Memory value, but its UTF-8 encoding exceeds MAX_VALUE_BYTES (1 MiB).

What this means

  • Canonical JSON serialization succeeds but its UTF-8 representation exceeds the one-MiB value bound. Memory validation and conditional writes preserve the current stored revision on rejection. This is global Memory, separate from conversation KV; diagnostic rendering does not perform additional storage operations.

Why this can happen

  • Canonical JSON serialization succeeds but its UTF-8 representation exceeds the one-MiB value bound.

How to diagnose it

  • Measure the encoded canonical value, not just the visible character count.

How to fix it

  • Reduce the value or split it across several keys so each compact, sorted-key UTF-8 JSON encoding is at most 1,048,576 bytes; do not silently truncate. The limit is MAX_VALUE_BYTES in src/agent_runtime/skills/memory/models.py.
  • Reduce or split the value to fit the operation’s advertised byte limit; do not silently truncate.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • Deliberately reduced or split complete values fit the bound without silent truncation.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Memory validation and conditional writes preserve the current stored revision on rejection. This is global Memory, separate from conversation KV; diagnostic rendering does not perform additional storage operations.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
